messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands with their back to the camera, then raises both arms to place their hands behind their head, and finally turns their body to the right in profile.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium-full shot from behind the subject.","clothing":"A white sleeveless tank top with a pink and orange palm-tree graphic, bright pink shorts with white trim, and red sneakers with white soles.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair.","identity":"A dark-skinned, slim, athletic person shown from behind, with no visible facial features.","scene":"A wet, reflective concrete plaza in a futuristic city at dusk, featuring a large glass-fronted building with a glowing green circular neon sign and pink ambient lighting."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced with a wet reflective futuristic plaza featuring a glass building, glowing green circular neon sign, and pink ambient lighting, closely matching the reference. The person remains in the same rear-facing position and performs the same arm-raising and turning motion, with similar framing and a static camera.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the old cobblestone street scene with the futuristic wet plaza environment from the reference, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, outfit, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the person's lighting is fully natural or slightly stylized by the new environment's neon colors.
unexpected_changes: The person's skin appears darker and more saturated in the output, likely due to the new scene lighting and color grading.
